## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmation: Energy and Financials showing leadership while Healthcare and Consumer Staples lag, and there is a major divergence across large caps (GOOGL, JNJ, LRCX mismatches), supporting a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +13.92% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.23% | 1M: +17.93%) ABOVE TREND; Financials follow: GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities showing tailwind: CEG (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +3.94%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Healthcare weak: LLY (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.72%) BELOW TREND, ABT (1W: -7.18% | 1M: -0.77%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Staples weak: PEP (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -5.76%) BELOW TREND. Industrials under pressure: BA (1W: -6.29% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MPC (1W: +13.92% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.23% | 1M: +17.93%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +12.64% | 1M: +13.11%) ABOVE TREND, GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate concentration (3 sectors represented: Energy 3/5, Financials 1/5, Technology 1/5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: IBM (1W: -29.09% | 1M: -21.02%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -9.33% | 1M: -30.26%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -11.19% | 1M: -8.09%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -8.05% | 1M: +11.77%) CORRECTION, PM (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W moves: MPC (1W: +13.92% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.23% | 1M: +17.93%) ABOVE TREND, GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +7.38% | 1M: +16.40%) ABOVE TREND; note major divergence (≥3 large caps) — GOOGL (1W: -2.05% | 1M: +0.49%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -5.01% | 1M: +6.51%) CORRECTION, LRCX (1W: +6.12% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY — watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology mixed with concentrated winners: NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +7.38% | 1M: +16.40%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +6.50%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.01% | 1M: -1.39%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -9.33% | 1M: -30.26%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.12% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY; sector among the 4/11 positive sectors.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials constructive: JPM (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +9.87%) ABOVE TREND, GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +11.59%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +10.77%) ABOVE TREND — breadth support within the 4 positive sectors; style leaning Value/Cyclical on bank and trading strength.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare pressured: LLY (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.72%) BELOW TREND, ABT (1W: -7.18% | 1M: -0.77%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -11.19% | 1M: -8.09%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +5.44%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: +0.75% | 1M: -7.34%) RECOVERY — overall sector weakness amid headline noise.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy and select Financials given current leadership (MPC, VLO, GS, JPM showing strength) and reduce exposure to weak Healthcare and Consumer Staples names under headline pressure. Style: mixed, leaning Value/Cyclical; monitor major-cap tech divergence before adding to Growth exposure.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND — momentum play if follow-through; MPC (1W: +13.92% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND — energy beat candidate. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -9.33% | 1M: -30.26%) BELOW TREND — headline and price confirm stress; IBM (1W: -29.09% | 1M: -21.02%) BELOW TREND — watch for further downside.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +6.16% | 1M: +3.23%) — clear leadership among sectors; Financials (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +6.83%) — continue to show strength. BEARISH: Healthcare (1W: -3.40% | 1M: +2.23%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -1.19%) — headline-driven weakness to monitor.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND for sustained follow-through as confirmation of tech risk-on; AAPL (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +6.50%) ABOVE TREND to hold recent 1M gains as a market internals check. Monitor GS/JPM (GS 1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08% ABOVE TREND; JPM 1W: +1.08% | 1M: +9.87% ABOVE TREND) for confirmation of Financials-led breadth; ORCL (1W: -9.33% | 1M: -30.26%) BELOW TREND is a trigger for risk-off micro-rotations if it worsens.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+85): LLY (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.72%) BELOW TREND — bullish FDA headline but price is falling, divergence (news not yet priced). PFE (+85): PFE (1W: +0.75% | 1M: -7.34%) RECOVERY — news and 1W lift are confirming a short-term recovery. JPM (+50): JPM (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +9.87%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/news flow confirming strength.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ORCL (-50): ORCL (1W: -9.33% | 1M: -30.26%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines and price are confirming distribution. UNH (-55): UNH (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +5.44%) CORRECTION — DOJ probe headline aligns with short-term weakness. CHTR (-50): CHTR (1W: -7.33% | 1M: -8.07%) BELOW TREND — negative coverage confirming pressure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed with a tilt toward Value/Cyclical given Energy and Financials leadership. NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +13.92% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is headline-driven divergence (LLY, ORCL, IBM) and mixed sentiment that could keep the market range-bound until follow-through is confirmed.
